title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 1

blocks.source_text: Welcome to the first snapshot of 26.4! We're kicking things off with a range of technical updates and improvements, including Vulkan becoming the default graphics API.
blocks.translated_text: 欢迎来到 26.4 的第一个快照！我们首先带来了一系列技术更新和改进，其中包括将 Vulkan 设为默认的图形 API。

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 变更

blocks.source_text: World Generation
blocks.translated_text: 世界生成

blocks.source_text: Upgrading worlds from before Caves and Cliffs will now also generate sulfur caves below old chunks
blocks.translated_text: 升级到 Caves and Cliffs 之前的世界时，现在也会在旧区块下方生成硫磺洞穴

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对块、物品和实体的小幅调整

blocks.source_text: Red and Brown Mushrooms can now be placed on any block with a solid top face regardless of lighting conditions
blocks.translated_text: 红色和棕色的蘑菇现在可以放置在任何顶部为实心的块上，不受光照条件的影响

blocks.source_text: They can still not spread unless the brightness is less than 13, or their support block overrides light requirements
blocks.translated_text: 不过它们仍然无法传播，除非亮度低于 13，或者它们的支撑块覆盖了光照要求

blocks.source_text: "Graphics API" Video Setting
blocks.translated_text: "图形 API" 视频设置

blocks.source_text: "Default" now behaves the same as "Prefer Vulkan"
blocks.translated_text: "默认" 设置现在与 "优先使用 Vulkan" 设置的行为相同

blocks.source_text: The game will no longer change the graphics API setting automatically if a startup crash is detected.
blocks.translated_text: 如果检测到启动时发生崩溃，游戏将不再自动更改图形 API 设置。

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术变更

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 122.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本现已更新至 122.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 98.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本现已更新至 98.0

blocks.source_text: Network Protocol
blocks.translated_text: 网络协议

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:mod_list Custom Packet Payload
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 minecraft:mod_list 自定义数据包内容

blocks.source_text: This packet is intended to inform servers about client mods to simplify debugging
blocks.translated_text: 此数据包用于向服务器通报客户端所使用的模组，以便简化调试过程

blocks.source_text: Vanilla client sends an empty packet at the start of configuration phase, as it does not know about any mods - that is still a responsibility of 3rd-party modding platforms
blocks.translated_text: 原始客户端在配置阶段会发送一个空数据包，因为它不知道客户端使用的是哪些模组——这仍然是第三方模组平台的职责

blocks.source_text: Modified minecraft:intention Packet
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:intention 数据包

blocks.source_text: The host field in the serverbound intention packet can now hold additional parameters (previously it stored only the domain name used for connecting to a server)
blocks.translated_text: 服务器返回的 intention 数据包中的 host 字段现在可以携带额外参数（之前仅存储用于连接服务器的域名）

blocks.source_text: The new format is similar to URI query strings - the domain can now optionally be followed by a ? character and then followed by key=value pairs separated by a & character
blocks.translated_text: 新格式类似于 URI 查询字符串——现在可以在域名后可选地添加一个？字符，随后是使用 & 字符分隔的键值对

blocks.source_text: Empty values can be omitted (including = sign)
blocks.translated_text: 空值可以省略（包括等号 =）

blocks.source_text: Keys and values are escaped according to the standard URI rules ("percent-encoded component")
blocks.translated_text: 键和值会按照标准的 URI 规则进行转义（“百分号编码”）

blocks.source_text: Keys starting with _ are reserved for vanilla use
blocks.translated_text: 以 _ 开头的键被保留用于原版 Minecraft（vanilla）

blocks.source_text: Example: example.com?key1=value2&key2
blocks.translated_text: 示例：example.com?key1=value2&key2

blocks.source_text: Users can now input properties in any "Server Address" field in the server list
blocks.translated_text: 用户现在可以在服务器列表中的任何“服务器地址”字段中输入属性

blocks.source_text: Additionally, any address in form of <id>@<host> will be parsed as <host>?_id=<id>
blocks.translated_text: 此外，任何形如 <id>@<host> 的地址都会被解析为 <host>?_id=<id>

blocks.source_text: If a server uses SRV DNS records, the host field will contain both original and resolved domains
blocks.translated_text: 如果服务器使用 SRV DNS 记录，主机字段将包含原始域名和解析后的域名

blocks.source_text: If the resolved domain is different from the original domain, the resolved one will be used as the "primary" one, while the original one will be added as _o ("origin") property
blocks.translated_text: 如果解析出的域名与原始域名不同，解析出的域名将被用作“主要”域名，而原始域名将被添加为 `_o`（“origin”）属性

blocks.source_text: Example host string: <redirected domain>?_o=<original domain>:<original port> , while the port field in the intention packet will be set to the resolved port value
blocks.translated_text: 示例主机字符串：`<重定向后的域名>?_o=<原始域名>:<原始端口>`，同时 `intention` 数据包中的端口字段将被设置为解析出的端口值

blocks.source_text: The field size has been extended to 1024 characters
blocks.translated_text: 该字段的大小已扩展到 1024 个字符

blocks.source_text: Note: since the minecraft:intent packet is unencrypted, properties should not be used for any security-sensitive purpose
blocks.translated_text: 注意：由于 `minecraft:intent` 数据包是未加密的，因此不应将其用于任何安全敏感的用途

blocks.source_text: Modified minecraft:transfer Packet
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 `minecraft:transfer` 数据包

blocks.source_text: Added properties field - a string to string map of properties that will be added to the host field in the minecraft:intent packet sent to the target server
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `properties` 字段——这是一个字符串到字符串的映射，其中包含将添加到发送到目标服务器的 `minecraft:intent` 数据包中的 `host` 字段的属性

blocks.source_text: Dedicated Server Properties
blocks.translated_text: 专用服务器属性

blocks.source_text: Added allowed-connection-ids
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `allowed-connection-ids` 属性

blocks.source_text: A list of comma-separted ids
blocks.translated_text: 一个以逗号分隔的 ID 列表

blocks.source_text: If non-empty, the server will match the values against _id property in minecraft:intent packet
blocks.translated_text: 如果该字段不为空，服务器会将其值与 minecraft:intent 包中的 _id 属性进行匹配

blocks.source_text: If there is no match, the server will reject the connection
blocks.translated_text: 如果没有匹配结果，服务器将拒绝该连接请求

blocks.source_text: This works both for both status and login connections, so any user connecting without the correct _id in the server address will not see the status and will not be able to join the server
blocks.translated_text: 这一规则既适用于状态请求，也适用于登录请求；因此，任何在服务器地址中缺少正确 _id 的用户都无法查看服务器状态，也无法加入服务器

blocks.source_text: Added status-contact-details field
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 status-contact-details 字段

blocks.source_text: If non-empty, the value of this field will be sent in the minecraft:status_response packet JSON payload under the contact property
blocks.translated_text: 如果该字段不为空，其值将作为 minecraft:status_response 包中的 contact 属性的一部分被发送

blocks.source_text: This value is meant to be used to signal a way to contact the server owners about the server, even if there is no website or other information about it
blocks.translated_text: 该字段的用途是提供一种方式，用于向服务器所有者报告服务器的相关问题，即使服务器没有官方网站或其他相关信息

blocks.source_text: This field is meant to be human-readable, but there are no other restrictions on field format
blocks.translated_text: 该字段应便于人类阅读，但对字段格式没有其他具体要求

blocks.source_text: Added enable-legacy-status field
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 `enable-legacy-status` 字段

blocks.source_text: This option allows disabling existing legacy (pre-1.7) server status and ping protocol handling
blocks.translated_text: 此选项允许禁用现有的旧版（1.7版之前的）服务器状态和ping协议处理

blocks.source_text: To preserve existing functionality, value defaults to true
blocks.translated_text: 为保留现有功能，该字段的默认值为 `true`

blocks.source_text: Note: enable-status needs to be set for any status information (modern or legacy) to be set
blocks.translated_text: 注意：必须先设置 `enable-status`，才能设置任何状态信息（无论是现代版本还是旧版）

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 122.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本 122.0

blocks.source_text: Entries for different biomes in multi-noise biome sources can no longer overlap across all noise parameters with the same offset
blocks.translated_text: 在多噪声生物群系源中，不同生物群系的条目不能再在具有相同偏移量的所有噪声参数上重叠

blocks.source_text: Commands
blocks.translated_text: 命令

blocks.source_text: The fillbiome command will now fill biomes with block accuracy
blocks.translated_text: `fillbiome` 命令现在会以精确的方块位置来填充生物群系

blocks.source_text: NBT conversion from floating point types to integer types now always converts to the closest possible valid number after rounding down
blocks.translated_text: 从浮点类型到整数类型的NBT转换现在总是向下取整后转换为最接近的有效数值

blocks.source_text: World Generation
blocks.translated_text: 世界生成

blocks.source_text: Features
blocks.translated_text: 特性（Features）

blocks.source_text: Changed
blocks.translated_text: 已更改（Changed）

blocks.source_text: straight_trunk_placer
blocks.translated_text: 直树放置器（straight_trunk_placer）

blocks.source_text: Added trunk_width field
blocks.translated_text: 新增了树干宽度属性（Added trunk_width field）

blocks.source_text: optional int provider, the width of the trunk centered around the origin
blocks.translated_text: 可选的整型参数：树干的中心距离原点的距离（optional int parameter: the distance of the trunk centered around the origin）

blocks.source_text: defaults to 1.0
blocks.translated_text: 默认值为1.0（Defaults to 1.0）

blocks.source_text: Placed Features
blocks.translated_text: 放置特性（Placed Features）

blocks.source_text: The possible domain in the XZ plane of Placed Features included in biomes is now validated
blocks.translated_text: 现在可以验证放置特性在生物群系中的XZ平面内的有效位置（The possible domain in the XZ plane of Placed Features included in biomes is now validated）

blocks.source_text: Feature placement can only occur within a 3x3 chunk region: as such, it is not valid for a Placed Feature to select a position outside of that range
blocks.translated_text: 特性放置只能在3x3的区块区域内进行；因此，放置特性时不能选择该范围之外的位置（Feature placement can only occur within a 3x3 chunk region; it is not valid for a Placed Feature to select a position outside of that range）

blocks.source_text: Note: the size of the feature itself is not currently taken into consideration, which may still overflow the chunk
blocks.translated_text: 注意：目前没有考虑特性本身的大小，它仍可能超出区块的范围（Note: the size of the feature itself is not currently taken into consideration, which may still overflow the chunk）

blocks.source_text: Placement Modifiers
blocks.translated_text: 放置修饰符（Placement Modifiers）

blocks.source_text: Changed
blocks.translated_text: 已更改（Changed）

blocks.source_text: cuboid
blocks.translated_text: 长方体（cuboid）

blocks.source_text: xz_size and y_size have been adjusted to represent the actual size of the cuboid, instead of implicitly being 1 block larger
blocks.translated_text: xz_size 和 y_size 已调整为长方体的实际大小，而不再是默认的比实际大 1 个方块

blocks.source_text: As such, an xz_size of 2 will actually produce a 2x2 cuboid instead of 3x3
blocks.translated_text: 因此，xz_size 为 2 时实际生成的是一个 2x2 的长方体，而不是 3x3 的

blocks.source_text: Changed
blocks.translated_text: 已更改（Changed）

blocks.source_text: fixed_placement
blocks.translated_text: 修复了放置问题（Fixed placement issue）

blocks.source_text: positions now requires at least one element
blocks.translated_text: 现在位置（positions）至少需要一个元素（positions now require at least one element）

blocks.source_text: Noise Settings
blocks.translated_text: 噪声设置（Noise Settings）

blocks.source_text: The default_block field has been removed
blocks.translated_text: 默认的 block 字段已被移除（The default_block field has been removed）

blocks.source_text: This is now always air - any other block should be defined by the Material Rule
blocks.translated_text: 现在这个区域始终是空气；其他任何方块都应该由材质规则（Material Rule）来定义

blocks.source_text: Material Conditions
blocks.translated_text: 材质条件（Material Conditions）

blocks.source_text: Updated
blocks.translated_text: 已更新

blocks.source_text: minecraft:steep
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:steep

blocks.source_text: No longer considers height modifications from Eroded Badlands "surface extensions" in an order-dependent way
blocks.translated_text: 不再以依赖顺序的方式考虑风化坏地（Eroded Badlands）的“地表扩展”（surface extensions）对高度的影响

blocks.source_text: Tags
blocks.translated_text: 标签（Tags）

blocks.source_text: Biome Tags
blocks.translated_text: 生物群系标签（Biome Tags）

blocks.source_text: Added #generated_in_below_zero_retrogen - biomes to generate below worlds that predate Caves and Cliffs
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 #generated_in_below_zero_retrogen 标签——用于生成位于洞穴（Caves）和悬崖（Cliffs）存在之前的世界

blocks.source_text: Added #is_cave collection tag
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 #is_cave 收集标签（collection tag）

blocks.source_text: Resource Pack Version 98.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本 98.0

blocks.source_text: Shaders & Post-process Effects
blocks.translated_text: 着色器与后期处理效果

blocks.source_text: Order-Independent Transparency shaders
blocks.translated_text: 与顺序无关的透明度着色器

blocks.source_text: The OIT algorithm was simplified by replacing the wavelet-based mathematics with depth bin-based accumulation
blocks.translated_text: OIT 算法通过用基于深度分区的累积方式替换基于小波的数学运算来简化

blocks.source_text: Slightly improved performance at least on some devices
blocks.translated_text: 至少在某些设备上，性能略有提升

blocks.source_text: Reduced floating point precision issues on average
blocks.translated_text: 平均而言，减少了浮点精度问题

blocks.source_text: OIT_WAVELET_RANK shader define was removed
blocks.translated_text: 移除了 OIT_WAVELET_RANK 着色器定义

blocks.source_text: OIT_COEFF_COUNT shader define was replaced by OIT_NUMBER_OF_DEPTH_BINS
blocks.translated_text: OIT_COEFF_COUNT 着色器定义被替换为 OIT_NUMBER_OF_DEPTH_BINS

blocks.source_text: OIT_COEFF_ATTACHMENT_COUNT shader define was renamed to OIT_TRANSMITTANCE_TARGET_COUNT
blocks.translated_text: OIT_COEFF_attachment_COUNT 着色器定义被重命名为 OIT_TRANSMITTANCETARGET_COUNT

blocks.source_text: Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 1
blocks.translated_text: 修复了 26.4 快照 1 中的漏洞

blocks.source_text: [MC-8959](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-8959) - The player automatically jumps when pressing against a block while in water
blocks.translated_text: [MC-8959](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-8959) - 玩家在水中的时候碰到方块时会发生自动跳跃现象

blocks.source_text: [MC-44560](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-44560) - When pushed to the edge of water or lava, entities jump by themselves
blocks.translated_text: [MC-44560](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-44560) - 当生物被推到水边或熔岩边缘时，它们会自动跳起来

blocks.source_text: [MC-50749](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-50749) - Jumping into water against a wall causes the player to bounce
blocks.translated_text: [MC-50749](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-50749) - 当玩家从墙上跳进水里时，会遇到弹跳现象

blocks.source_text: [MC-123848](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-123848) - Item frames (and items within) drop atop the block they're attached to instead of under it when removed from a ceiling
blocks.translated_text: [MC-123848](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-123848) - 当物品从天花板上掉下来时，物品框架（以及物品本身）会落在所附着的方块上方，而不是下方

blocks.source_text: [MC-135211](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135211) - Entities automatically jump when falling into 1-block-deep water from certain heights
blocks.translated_text: [MC-135211](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135211) - 当生物从特定高度掉入1格深的水中时，会自动跳起来

blocks.source_text: [MC-135212](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135212) - Entities automatically jump when falling into water of any depth from certain heights
blocks.translated_text: [MC-135212](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135212) - 当生物从任何高度掉入水中时，会自动跳起来

blocks.source_text: [MC-262252](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-262252) - The generation of lush caves and dripstone caves is poorly defined
blocks.translated_text: [MC-262252] - 茂盛洞穴和滴石洞穴的生成机制不够明确

blocks.source_text: [MC-276879](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-276879) - /data truncates floats when casting to longs, but rounds down in all other cases
blocks.translated_text: [MC-276879](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-276879) - 在将浮点数转换为长整型时，数据会被截断；但在其他所有情况下都会向下取整

blocks.source_text: [MC-278651](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-278651) - The host name in handshake packets for SRV records is inconsistent
blocks.translated_text: [MC-278651](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-278651) - SRV 记录中的主机名不一致

blocks.source_text: [MC-296053](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-296053) - Item frames don't update properly when modifying their Facing NBT tag
blocks.translated_text: [MC-296053] - 修改物品的方向 NBT 标签时，物品帧不会正确更新

blocks.source_text: [MC-299060](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-299060) - Setting item frames' direction with commands can cause desyncs
blocks.translated_text: [MC-299060] - 使用命令设置物品方向可能导致数据不同步

blocks.source_text: [MC-303702](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-303702) - Small gaps still appear in item models
blocks.translated_text: [MC-303702] - 物品模型中仍然存在小间隙

blocks.source_text: [MC-307065](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-307065) - Missing optimization for the side faces of the builtin/generated item model
blocks.translated_text: [MC-307065] - 内置生成的物品模型的侧面没有进行优化

blocks.source_text: [MC-310051](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310051) - Floating point cancellation artifacts from bits.fsh
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310051](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310051) - 由于 bits.fsh 导致浮点数计算误差的问题

blocks.source_text: [MC-310131](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310131) - Placeable entities momentarily appear at the wrong location when placed
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310131] - 可放置的实体在放置时偶尔会显示在错误的位置

blocks.source_text: [MC-310767](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310767) - Pipelines always declare a D32_FLOAT depth attachment format with the Vulkan rendering backend
blocks.translated_text: [MC-310767] - 使用 Vulkan 渲染后端时，管道（pipelines）总是声明 D32_FLOAT 深度附加格式

blocks.source_text: [MC-311195](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311195) - Placed armor stands are rotated incorrectly for one tick
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311195] - 放置的装甲架会在一个游戏刻（tick）内发生错误的旋转

blocks.source_text: [MC-311265](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311265) - The world border renders incorrectly from outside
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311265] - 从世界边界外部看时，世界边界显示不正确

blocks.source_text: [MC-311473](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311473) - Duplicating items with the scroll wheel in Creative mode can produce ghost items
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311473] - 在创造模式下使用滚轮复制物品时可能会出现幽灵物品

blocks.source_text: [MC-311582](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311582) - The texture of desert pyramid maps has one inconsistent pixel compared to the others
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311582] - 沙漠金字塔地图的纹理中有一个与其他纹理不一致的像素

blocks.source_text: [MC-311726](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311726) - The water inside waterlogged copper grates has the falling fluid state property set to true
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311726] - 被水淹没的铜栅栏中的水具有“下落流体”状态属性（falling fluid state property）

blocks.source_text: [MC-311727](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311727) - The check for whether a player is standing on air doesn't use the player's updated position
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311727] - 检查玩家是否站在空中的逻辑没有使用玩家更新后的位置信息

blocks.source_text: [MC-311773](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311773) - Red and brown mushrooms cannot be placed at any light level, unlike in Bedrock Edition
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311773] - 红色和棕色的蘑菇不能在任何光照等级下生成，这与基岩版（Bedrock Edition）不同

blocks.source_text: [MC-311786](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311786) - Running /test run with a rotationSteps value that is out of range causes an error

blocks.source_text: [MC-311788](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311788) - Teleporting item frames moves them further than it should visually
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311788] - 传送物品时，物品在被传送过程中的移动距离比视觉显示的要远

blocks.source_text: [MC-311818](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311818) - Traveling to the End in Spectator mode regenerates the obsidian platform
blocks.translated_text: [MC-311818] - 在观众模式下前往末地时，黑曜石平台会重新生成

content:
Welcome to the first snapshot of 26.4! We're kicking things off with a range of technical updates and improvements, including Vulkan becoming the default graphics API.

Changes

World Generation

Upgrading worlds from before Caves and Cliffs will now also generate sulfur caves below old chunks

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Red and Brown Mushrooms can now be placed on any block with a solid top face regardless of lighting conditions

They can still not spread unless the brightness is less than 13, or their support block overrides light requirements

"Graphics API" Video Setting

"Default" now behaves the same as "Prefer Vulkan"

The game will no longer change the graphics API setting automatically if a startup crash is detected.

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 122.0

The Resource Pack version is now 98.0

Network Protocol

Added minecraft:mod_list Custom Packet Payload

This packet is intended to inform servers about client mods to simplify debugging

Vanilla client sends an empty packet at the start of configuration phase, as it does not know about any mods - that is still a responsibility of 3rd-party modding platforms

Modified minecraft:intention Packet

The host field in the serverbound intention packet can now hold additional parameters (previously it stored only the domain name used for connecting to a server)

The new format is similar to URI query strings - the domain can now optionally be followed by a ? character and then followed by key=value pairs separated by a & character

Empty values can be omitted (including = sign)

Keys and values are escaped according to the standard URI rules ("percent-encoded component")

Keys starting with _ are reserved for vanilla use

Example: example.com?key1=value2&key2

Users can now input properties in any "Server Address" field in the server list

Additionally, any address in form of <id>@<host> will be parsed as <host>?_id=<id>

If a server uses SRV DNS records, the host field will contain both original and resolved domains

If the resolved domain is different from the original domain, the resolved one will be used as the "primary" one, while the original one will be added as _o ("origin") property

Example host string: <redirected domain>?_o=<original domain>:<original port> , while the port field in the intention packet will be set to the resolved port value

The field size has been extended to 1024 characters

Note: since the minecraft:intent packet is unencrypted, properties should not be used for any security-sensitive purpose

Modified minecraft:transfer Packet

Added properties field - a string to string map of properties that will be added to the host field in the minecraft:intent packet sent to the target server

Dedicated Server Properties

Added allowed-connection-ids

A list of comma-separted ids

If non-empty, the server will match the values against _id property in minecraft:intent packet

If there is no match, the server will reject the connection

This works both for both status and login connections, so any user connecting without the correct _id in the server address will not see the status and will not be able to join the server

Added status-contact-details field

If non-empty, the value of this field will be sent in the minecraft:status_response packet JSON payload under the contact property

This value is meant to be used to signal a way to contact the server owners about the server, even if there is no website or other information about it

This field is meant to be human-readable, but there are no other restrictions on field format

Added enable-legacy-status field

This option allows disabling existing legacy (pre-1.7) server status and ping protocol handling

To preserve existing functionality, value defaults to true

Note: enable-status needs to be set for any status information (modern or legacy) to be set

Data Pack Version 122.0

Entries for different biomes in multi-noise biome sources can no longer overlap across all noise parameters with the same offset

Commands

The fillbiome command will now fill biomes with block accuracy

NBT conversion from floating point types to integer types now always converts to the closest possible valid number after rounding down

World Generation

Features

Changed

straight_trunk_placer

Added trunk_width field

optional int provider, the width of the trunk centered around the origin

defaults to 1.0

Placed Features

The possible domain in the XZ plane of Placed Features included in biomes is now validated

Feature placement can only occur within a 3x3 chunk region: as such, it is not valid for a Placed Feature to select a position outside of that range

Note: the size of the feature itself is not currently taken into consideration, which may still overflow the chunk

Placement Modifiers

Changed

cuboid

xz_size and y_size have been adjusted to represent the actual size of the cuboid, instead of implicitly being 1 block larger

As such, an xz_size of 2 will actually produce a 2x2 cuboid instead of 3x3

Changed

fixed_placement

positions now requires at least one element

Noise Settings

The default_block field has been removed

This is now always air - any other block should be defined by the Material Rule

Material Conditions

Updated

minecraft:steep

No longer considers height modifications from Eroded Badlands "surface extensions" in an order-dependent way

Tags

Biome Tags

Added #generated_in_below_zero_retrogen - biomes to generate below worlds that predate Caves and Cliffs

Added #is_cave collection tag

Resource Pack Version 98.0

Shaders & Post-process Effects

Order-Independent Transparency shaders

The OIT algorithm was simplified by replacing the wavelet-based mathematics with depth bin-based accumulation

Slightly improved performance at least on some devices

Reduced floating point precision issues on average

OIT_WAVELET_RANK shader define was removed

OIT_COEFF_COUNT shader define was replaced by OIT_NUMBER_OF_DEPTH_BINS

OIT_COEFF_ATTACHMENT_COUNT shader define was renamed to OIT_TRANSMITTANCE_TARGET_COUNT

Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 1

[MC-8959](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-8959) - The player automatically jumps when pressing against a block while in water

[MC-44560](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-44560) - When pushed to the edge of water or lava, entities jump by themselves

[MC-50749](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-50749) - Jumping into water against a wall causes the player to bounce

[MC-123848](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-123848) - Item frames (and items within) drop atop the block they're attached to instead of under it when removed from a ceiling

[MC-135211](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135211) - Entities automatically jump when falling into 1-block-deep water from certain heights

[MC-135212](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135212) - Entities automatically jump when falling into water of any depth from certain heights

[MC-262252](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-262252) - The generation of lush caves and dripstone caves is poorly defined

[MC-276879](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-276879) - /data truncates floats when casting to longs, but rounds down in all other cases

[MC-278651](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-278651) - The host name in handshake packets for SRV records is inconsistent

[MC-296053](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-296053) - Item frames don't update properly when modifying their Facing NBT tag

[MC-299060](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-299060) - Setting item frames' direction with commands can cause desyncs

[MC-303702](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-303702) - Small gaps still appear in item models

[MC-307065](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-307065) - Missing optimization for the side faces of the builtin/generated item model

[MC-310051](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310051) - Floating point cancellation artifacts from bits.fsh

[MC-310131](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310131) - Placeable entities momentarily appear at the wrong location when placed

[MC-310767](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310767) - Pipelines always declare a D32_FLOAT depth attachment format with the Vulkan rendering backend

[MC-311195](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311195) - Placed armor stands are rotated incorrectly for one tick

[MC-311265](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311265) - The world border renders incorrectly from outside

[MC-311473](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311473) - Duplicating items with the scroll wheel in Creative mode can produce ghost items

[MC-311582](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311582) - The texture of desert pyramid maps has one inconsistent pixel compared to the others

[MC-311726](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311726) - The water inside waterlogged copper grates has the falling fluid state property set to true

[MC-311727](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311727) - The check for whether a player is standing on air doesn't use the player's updated position

[MC-311773](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311773) - Red and brown mushrooms cannot be placed at any light level, unlike in Bedrock Edition

[MC-311786](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311786) - Running /test run with a rotationSteps value that is out of range causes an error

[MC-311788](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311788) - Teleporting item frames moves them further than it should visually

[MC-311818](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311818) - Traveling to the End in Spectator mode regenerates the obsidian platform

[MC-311836](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311836) - Minecart sounds are now distorted

[MC-311859](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311859) - Damaged dyed wolf armor no longer shows cracks in the colored parts

[MC-311966](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311966) - The tooltip of the "Quit Shortcuts" option calls the Command key "Cmd"

Get the Snapshot

Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.

**Testing versions can corrupt your world, so please backup and/or run them in a different folder from your main worlds.**

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/30c3b4fddc0821345a9464ab1201f0ef44f570dd/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary) !

Want to give feedback?

For any feedback and suggestions, head over to the [Feedback site](https://feedback.minecraft.net/) . If you're feeling chatty, join us over at the [official Minecraft Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft) .
translated_content:
欢迎来到 26.4 的第一个快照！我们首先带来了一系列技术更新和改进，其中包括将 Vulkan 设为默认的图形 API。

变更

世界生成

升级到 Caves and Cliffs 之前的世界时，现在也会在旧区块下方生成硫磺洞穴

对块、物品和实体的小幅调整

红色和棕色的蘑菇现在可以放置在任何顶部为实心的块上，不受光照条件的影响

不过它们仍然无法传播，除非亮度低于 13，或者它们的支撑块覆盖了光照要求

"图形 API" 视频设置

"默认" 设置现在与 "优先使用 Vulkan" 设置的行为相同

如果检测到启动时发生崩溃，游戏将不再自动更改图形 API 设置。

技术变更

数据包版本现已更新至 122.0

资源包版本现已更新至 98.0

网络协议

新增了 minecraft:mod_list 自定义数据包内容

此数据包用于向服务器通报客户端所使用的模组，以便简化调试过程

原始客户端在配置阶段会发送一个空数据包，因为它不知道客户端使用的是哪些模组——这仍然是第三方模组平台的职责

修改了 minecraft:intention 数据包

服务器返回的 intention 数据包中的 host 字段现在可以携带额外参数（之前仅存储用于连接服务器的域名）

新格式类似于 URI 查询字符串——现在可以在域名后可选地添加一个？字符，随后是使用 & 字符分隔的键值对

空值可以省略（包括等号 =）

键和值会按照标准的 URI 规则进行转义（“百分号编码”）

以 _ 开头的键被保留用于原版 Minecraft（vanilla）

示例：example.com?key1=value2&key2

用户现在可以在服务器列表中的任何“服务器地址”字段中输入属性

此外，任何形如 <id>@<host> 的地址都会被解析为 <host>?_id=<id>

如果服务器使用 SRV DNS 记录，主机字段将包含原始域名和解析后的域名

如果解析出的域名与原始域名不同，解析出的域名将被用作“主要”域名，而原始域名将被添加为 `_o`（“origin”）属性

示例主机字符串：`<重定向后的域名>?_o=<原始域名>:<原始端口>`，同时 `intention` 数据包中的端口字段将被设置为解析出的端口值

该字段的大小已扩展到 1024 个字符

注意：由于 `minecraft:intent` 数据包是未加密的，因此不应将其用于任何安全敏感的用途

修改了 `minecraft:transfer` 数据包

添加了 `properties` 字段——这是一个字符串到字符串的映射，其中包含将添加到发送到目标服务器的 `minecraft:intent` 数据包中的 `host` 字段的属性

专用服务器属性

添加了 `allowed-connection-ids` 属性

一个以逗号分隔的 ID 列表

如果该字段不为空，服务器会将其值与 minecraft:intent 包中的 _id 属性进行匹配

如果没有匹配结果，服务器将拒绝该连接请求

这一规则既适用于状态请求，也适用于登录请求；因此，任何在服务器地址中缺少正确 _id 的用户都无法查看服务器状态，也无法加入服务器

新增了 status-contact-details 字段

如果该字段不为空，其值将作为 minecraft:status_response 包中的 contact 属性的一部分被发送

该字段的用途是提供一种方式，用于向服务器所有者报告服务器的相关问题，即使服务器没有官方网站或其他相关信息

该字段应便于人类阅读，但对字段格式没有其他具体要求

添加了 `enable-legacy-status` 字段

此选项允许禁用现有的旧版（1.7版之前的）服务器状态和ping协议处理

为保留现有功能，该字段的默认值为 `true`

注意：必须先设置 `enable-status`，才能设置任何状态信息（无论是现代版本还是旧版）

数据包版本 122.0

在多噪声生物群系源中，不同生物群系的条目不能再在具有相同偏移量的所有噪声参数上重叠

命令

`fillbiome` 命令现在会以精确的方块位置来填充生物群系

从浮点类型到整数类型的NBT转换现在总是向下取整后转换为最接近的有效数值

世界生成

特性（Features）

已更改（Changed）

直树放置器（straight_trunk_placer）

新增了树干宽度属性（Added trunk_width field）

可选的整型参数：树干的中心距离原点的距离（optional int parameter: the distance of the trunk centered around the origin）

默认值为1.0（Defaults to 1.0）

放置特性（Placed Features）

现在可以验证放置特性在生物群系中的XZ平面内的有效位置（The possible domain in the XZ plane of Placed Features included in biomes is now validated）

特性放置只能在3x3的区块区域内进行；因此，放置特性时不能选择该范围之外的位置（Feature placement can only occur within a 3x3 chunk region; it is not valid for a Placed Feature to select a position outside of that range）

注意：目前没有考虑特性本身的大小，它仍可能超出区块的范围（Note: the size of the feature itself is not currently taken into consideration, which may still overflow the chunk）

放置修饰符（Placement Modifiers）

已更改（Changed）

长方体（cuboid）

xz_size 和 y_size 已调整为长方体的实际大小，而不再是默认的比实际大 1 个方块

因此，xz_size 为 2 时实际生成的是一个 2x2 的长方体，而不是 3x3 的

已更改（Changed）

修复了放置问题（Fixed placement issue）

现在位置（positions）至少需要一个元素（positions now require at least one element）

噪声设置（Noise Settings）

默认的 block 字段已被移除（The default_block field has been removed）

现在这个区域始终是空气；其他任何方块都应该由材质规则（Material Rule）来定义

材质条件（Material Conditions）

已更新

minecraft:steep

不再以依赖顺序的方式考虑风化坏地（Eroded Badlands）的“地表扩展”（surface extensions）对高度的影响

标签（Tags）

生物群系标签（Biome Tags）

新增了 #generated_in_below_zero_retrogen 标签——用于生成位于洞穴（Caves）和悬崖（Cliffs）存在之前的世界

新增了 #is_cave 收集标签（collection tag）

资源包版本 98.0

着色器与后期处理效果

与顺序无关的透明度着色器

OIT 算法通过用基于深度分区的累积方式替换基于小波的数学运算来简化

至少在某些设备上，性能略有提升

平均而言，减少了浮点精度问题

移除了 OIT_WAVELET_RANK 着色器定义

OIT_COEFF_COUNT 着色器定义被替换为 OIT_NUMBER_OF_DEPTH_BINS

OIT_COEFF_attachment_COUNT 着色器定义被重命名为 OIT_TRANSMITTANCETARGET_COUNT

修复了 26.4 快照 1 中的漏洞

[MC-8959](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-8959) - 玩家在水中的时候碰到方块时会发生自动跳跃现象

[MC-44560](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-44560) - 当生物被推到水边或熔岩边缘时，它们会自动跳起来

[MC-50749](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-50749) - 当玩家从墙上跳进水里时，会遇到弹跳现象

[MC-123848](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-123848) - 当物品从天花板上掉下来时，物品框架（以及物品本身）会落在所附着的方块上方，而不是下方

[MC-135211](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135211) - 当生物从特定高度掉入1格深的水中时，会自动跳起来

[MC-135212](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-135212) - 当生物从任何高度掉入水中时，会自动跳起来

[MC-262252] - 茂盛洞穴和滴石洞穴的生成机制不够明确

[MC-276879](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-276879) - 在将浮点数转换为长整型时，数据会被截断；但在其他所有情况下都会向下取整

[MC-278651](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-278651) - SRV 记录中的主机名不一致

[MC-296053] - 修改物品的方向 NBT 标签时，物品帧不会正确更新

[MC-299060] - 使用命令设置物品方向可能导致数据不同步

[MC-303702] - 物品模型中仍然存在小间隙

[MC-307065] - 内置生成的物品模型的侧面没有进行优化

[MC-310051](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-310051) - 由于 bits.fsh 导致浮点数计算误差的问题

[MC-310131] - 可放置的实体在放置时偶尔会显示在错误的位置

[MC-310767] - 使用 Vulkan 渲染后端时，管道（pipelines）总是声明 D32_FLOAT 深度附加格式

[MC-311195] - 放置的装甲架会在一个游戏刻（tick）内发生错误的旋转

[MC-311265] - 从世界边界外部看时，世界边界显示不正确

[MC-311473] - 在创造模式下使用滚轮复制物品时可能会出现幽灵物品

[MC-311582] - 沙漠金字塔地图的纹理中有一个与其他纹理不一致的像素

[MC-311726] - 被水淹没的铜栅栏中的水具有“下落流体”状态属性（falling fluid state property）

[MC-311727] - 检查玩家是否站在空中的逻辑没有使用玩家更新后的位置信息

[MC-311773] - 红色和棕色的蘑菇不能在任何光照等级下生成，这与基岩版（Bedrock Edition）不同

[MC-311786] - 使用超出范围的rotationSteps值运行测试程序会引发错误

[MC-311788] - 传送物品时，物品在被传送过程中的移动距离比视觉显示的要远

[MC-311818] - 在观众模式下前往末地时，黑曜石平台会重新生成

[MC-311836] - 矿车的相关音效现在出现了失真现象

[MC-311859] - 变色的狼人护甲在损坏后，其有色部分不再显示裂纹
